scenes.script:
Miss Nova says: Aapko pata hai jab English bolne ki baari aati hai, toh aap freeze kyun ho jaate ho?
Miss Nova says: Kyunki sirf padhne se aap bolna nahi seekh sakte. Aapko actually out loud baat karni padegi.
Miss Nova says: Lekin logon ke saath practice karna scary hota hai. Aapko tension hoti hai ki wo aapki mistakes ko judge karenge.
Miss Nova says: Main hoon Miss Nova, Supernova AI par aapki personal AI teacher. Mere saath aap 1000 mistakes bhi karo, main aap par kabhi nahi hansungi.
scenes.on_screen_text:
English bolte waqt
freeze kyun ho jaate ho?
Actually out loud bolna padega
Lekin log mistakes judge karte hain
Main hoon Miss Nova
aapki AI teacher
1000 mistakes karo
main kabhi nahi hansungi

scenes.script:
Miss Nova says: Main sabko wahi same boring lessons nahi deti.
Miss Nova says: Main aapka exact level analyze karti hoon aur sirf aapke liye ek personalized plan banati hoon.
Miss Nova says: Hum saath mein real-life situations practice karte hain, jaise aapka next job interview ya koi client call.
Miss Nova says: Aur jab aap kahin atak jaate ho, toh main aapko Hindi mein logic samjhati hoon, taaki aapko actually samajh aaye.
scenes.on_screen_text:
Personalized plan
sirf aapke liye
Real-life situations practice karo
jaise job interview
Logic samjhiye
Hindi mein

scenes.script:
Miss Nova says: Har roz ghanton feed scroll karke apna time waste karna band kijiye.
Miss Nova says: Bas din mein 15 minutes mere saath practice kijiye.
scenes.on_screen_text:

Roz bas 15 minutes
mere saath practice kijiye

scenes.script: Miss Nova says: Aaj hi Supernova AI download kijiye, aur aap 1 month ke andar zyada confidently bolna shuru kar denge.

parsed.self_critique_fixed: Ensured the hook opens with native Hindi ('Aapko pata hai...'). Applied T5 to swap 'your own language' to 'Hindi'. Maintained polite 'aap' register for Miss Nova. Used natural, conversational code-mixed Hindi (WhatsApp style romanization) without any literary or Sanskritized words. Kept numbers as English numerals per T2h.

violations.quote: Har roz ghanton feed scroll karke apna time waste karna band kijiye.
violations.why: It violates the policy by explicitly trashing Meta's feed scrolling surface as 'time waste' instead of framing it as a neutral time-reallocation anchor.
violations.fix: Har roz ghanton feed scroll karne ke bajaye, bas 15 minutes nikal kar practice kijiye.

safety.summary: The script is highly compliant overall, with only a moderate violation in Scene 3 where feed scrolling is trashed as a waste of time.
